# brig sandbox start

Start a stopped sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox start [VM] SANDBOX
```

## Description

Start a stopped sandbox, or one in error, as openshell sandbox start does.
Its /sandbox is as it was left; programs that ran before do not.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
